definitions.gloss: to stand firm; to plant one's feet
definitions.explanation: To spread one's legs and plant one's feet firmly to maintain balance or resist force.
To persist or endure through a difficult situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両足|りょうあし}→両足：28926_ryouashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}って⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: To stand firm with both feet planted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けないように→負ける：01134_makeru⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}った。
examples.english: I braced myself so as not to be blown over by the strong wind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、テーブル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つかまって→つかまる：01959_tsukamaru⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}った。
examples.english: During the earthquake, I grabbed the table and braced myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相撲|すもう}→相撲：00390_sumou⟧⟦では→では：noentry⟧、⟦{土俵|どひょう}→土俵：12010_dohyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}って⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}し{返|かえ}すこと→押し返す：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: In sumo, it's important to plant your feet on the ring and push back against your opponent.

examples.japanese: ここ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}りどころ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This is the moment to dig in.

examples.japanese: もう⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}れば⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: If you hold out a little longer, you can pass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、もう⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}ろう。
examples.english: It's tough, but let's hang in there a bit longer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}ったおかげ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}てた→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to holding out until the end, I was able to win the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くても→悪い：00908_warui⟧{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}って⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けてきた→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、やっとお⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧さん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えてきた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of persevering and keeping the store open even during the bad economy, customers have finally started to increase.

notes:
{踏|ふ}ん{張|ば}る has both a physical sense (planting feet firmly) and a figurative sense (persevering through difficulty).
